purpose: Synthetic-only probe of FFmpeg CENC decryption key handoff without putting key material in process arguments or logs
input: Locally generated one-second sine encoded as FLAC in MP4, then encrypted with synthetic CENC AES-CTR key and KID; no user media, provider URL, or real key

tests.note: Control only; the key is present in argv, so this is unsuitable for the requested handoff.

tests.method: CLI -decryption_key with key file path as value
tests.diagnostic: FFmpeg rejected the path as an invalid binary option value.
FFmpeg parses the descriptor path as the option value; it does not read key bytes from that descriptor.
This build reports the input-private option as unrecognized in the file-argument form.

tests.method: Native libavformat API; inherited pipe FD 3 supplies 16 raw key bytes; helper converts them in memory to hex and sets the input option through AVDictionary before avformat_open_input

implementation_path: Have the trusted native playback process receive the 16-byte key over an inherited pipe or equivalent private IPC, then call libavformat with an in-memory decryption_key option before opening the MP4. Do not invoke the ffmpeg CLI with the key; this FFmpeg build's private demuxer option did not accept file or procfd indirection. The probe validates demux/decryption and packet reads, not full decode, seek, device playback, or production lifecycle behavior.
